title: LibraryFile
description:
A library file: `libraries/<area>.json`. Libraries are the globals that
are not classes: datatype tables (`Vector3`), function libraries (`task`)
and global functions (`typeof`), plus globals that name an instance
(`game`, `workspace`, `script`) through `class`.

class.description:
For a global that is an instance: its class, whose members (with the
inherited ones) are the global's members.

members.description:
The table's members (`Vector3.new`, `Vector3.zero`, `task.wait`):
functions, constants and fields. Empty for a function or an instance
global.

value_members.description:
For a datatype: the members of its values (`v.Magnitude`, `v:Dot(w)`),
properties and methods.

record.description:
For a datatype stored in component fields: its stored form, a record
type of this name registered when the class registry is built, so a
class property of this type can use `own` storage. Record fields take
scalar types only (as for `own` properties, without `Instance`).

deprecated.description: Set when the global is deprecated: what to use instead (`RE9101`).

status.description: How far the global itself is implemented.

doc.description: What it is, in our words.

LibraryMemberDoc.description: One member of a library table, or of a datatype's values.

kind.description: What kind of member it is; `function` when left out.

params.description:
The parameters of a function or method (after the value itself, for a
method).

returns.description: The result types of a function or method.

type.description: The type of a constant or property.

yields.description: True if the call can yield the calling coroutine.

deprecated.description: Set when the member is deprecated: what to use instead (`RE9101`).

doc.description: What it does, in our words.

LibraryMemberKind.description: What kind of member a library member is.

oneOf.description:
A value read (and maybe written) with `.`: a library field, or on a
datatype's values a field such as `Magnitude`.
On a datatype's values: called with `:` (`v:Dot(w)`).

ParamDoc.description: A parameter of a method or event.

type.description: The type, as for a property, plus `any`, `table`, `function` and `...`.

optional.description: True if it may be left out.

Status.description: How far a class, member, enum or library is implemented.

oneOf.description: Behaviour matches for the cases our tests cover.
Exists with a documented gap (see the row's `note`).
Raises `RE9001` or `RE9002` with the member's name.

RecordFieldDoc.description: One field of a datatype's stored form.
